items.t: CoreWeave Eyes $4.5B Loan, but Bankruptcy Odds Rise to 21% on Prediction Markets
items.sum: CoreWeave’s (NASDAQ:CRWV) bonds due in 2031 sank to record lows Wednesday, pushing their yield to about 18%. That same day, Bloomberg reported that Wall Street banks are preparing to sell $4.5 billion in new CoreWeave debt at less than half...

items.t: Nvidia, CoreWeave Face New U.S. Restrictions on China AI Chip Access
items.sum: Nvidia chip sellers are reportedly restricting sales to cloud providers serving Chinese customers.

items.t: CoreWeave Default Insurance Costs Hit Record 15.34% Amid AI Debt Fears
items.sum: Credit markets signal growing concerns about debt-funded artificial intelligence infrastructure investments.
The bear case on CoreWeave, Inc.: $51 billion in debt and obligations, some bonds yielding 17%-18%, competition and insider selling make shares non-investable.

items.t: Wells Fargo Doubles Down on CoreWeave Stock Amid Selloff
items.sum: Mounting financial fears may be overshadowing a compelling opportunity.

items.t: CoreWeave Seeks $4.5 Billion Meta-Backed Loan as Bond Yields Hit 18%
items.sum: The AI infrastructure provider seeks lower borrowing costs through chip-backed financing amid rising credit concerns.
